inverse_solution_audit.scope: Read-only bounded symmetric endpoint check, using the finalized PDF and matching AUX; no additional macro or checker changes.
inverse_solution_audit.method: Within the Solutions to the exercises bookmark range, enumerate lines containing only an exercise number and a bold span. Match each sol:<exercise-label> AUX entry to its originating exercise number and unique rendered solution heading, then resolve its named destination.

comparison_rules.folio: AUX page field equals rendered page label exactly
comparison_rules.page: Resolved named destination page equals the rendered heading page
comparison_rules.vertical_position: Convert destination PDF coordinates through page.transformation_matrix; y must lie from24pt above heading top to2pt below heading bottom
comparison_rules.inventory: Exactly one rendered heading and one corresponding AUX label per exercise number; all212 exercised in each direction
